name: eUTxO
description_long: Visual Cardano blockchain explorer built around the eUTxO model. Instead of tables, transactions and blocks are rendered as interactive physics-driven graphs showing how inputs and outputs connect, alongside NFTs, native tokens, and per-block TPS comparisons against account-model chains. Includes a live mempool view, a records page of notable blocks and transactions, dark mode, fullscreen ZEN mode, and shareable screenshots.
